violated_contract: When an admission boundary validates a durable job payload against a closed key set, every field that any producer can add must be enumerated in that set (as required or optional). A producer that conditionally adds a field the boundary does not list passes every test that omits the condition, then fails in production the first time a client triggers it, after the caller has already been told the work was accepted.
canonical_prevention: Keep one shared key validator that names required and optional fields, use it at every boundary that checks the payload, and keep a unit test that enqueues a payload with each conditional producer field present.
